data.overview: A mother travels between parallel worlds, killing the man who murdered her daughter in each one. Her cycle of revenge begins to break when she rescues a sharp teenager marked by the same predator and must choose what kind of future she wants to leave her.
data.tagline: Vengeance has another version of you.
data.title: Second Chance, Same Killer
